notification_preferences.owner: The live authenticated session user only; no Admin permission grants ownership of another user's preferences.

validation.integer_revisions: JSON integer, never strings/doubles/bools; 0 <= previous <= 1000000000; 1 <= revision <= 1000000000
validation.revision_binding: previous_revision equals the exact submitted expected revision; changed true requires revision=previous+1, changed false requires revision=previous
validation.identity_binding: feature flag key and enabled exactly match submitted values; preference user_id equals active Auth user captured at dispatch and acknowledgment
validation.session_binding: Reject a late reply after a session/user change; never mutate local state on missing, malformed or conflict ACK.
validation.conflict: SQLSTATE 40001: retain saved state and dirty intended edit; reload current server revision explicitly before retry; never silently rebase or retry an overwrite.
validation.direct_preferences_write: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE are revoked; existing direct upsert must migrate before acceptance.
validation.no_change: Server returns unchanged revision and timestamp; no immutable change event is emitted.
